description: Resolves the cooked/raw weight ratio from Knowledge only: method-specific key, then the generic "cooked" key, then 1. Never invents a factor — a missing yield is a gap to report through the feedback channel, not to guess in the client. Mirrors the pocket-nutrition-ml router.

cases.why: The rice bug. Knowledge aggregates most yields under the generic "cooked" state key, so a request for "boiled" must fall back to it instead of returning 1.
A method-specific override takes precedence over the generic key.
Raw means no conversion, even with a "cooked" key present. This is checked before any lookup, so a port must not reorder the branches.
No invented conversion when Knowledge has no yield at all.
"cooked" is a real method value the API accepts, not only a fallback key.
